character.prompt: A sturdy, kindly woman in her fifties with a practical build and a quietly weary warmth — someone who just woke from a very long sleep and is facing forward anyway. Greying chestnut hair pinned up loosely with a few escaping strands. She wears the simple, lived-in clothes of a country general-store keeper: homespun linen blouse with rolled sleeves, a well-worn canvas apron with deep pockets, a long woolen skirt, and sturdy boots. Small homey details read even at low resolution — a thistle in her apron pocket, a brass ring of shop keys at her belt. Approachable, grounded, motherly but not soft, with a gentle expression suggested in just a few pixels. Limited, harmonious palette of warm earth tones — oatmeal, chestnut-brown, dusty sage, with a small pop of thistle dusty-rose. Soft warm sunlit shading with chunky deliberate pixel clusters, bold readable silhouette, crisp clean pixel edges, hand-placed pixel detail, classic 16-bit cozy RPG style.
